maria: Free curbside pickup in SF Soma — 27" IPS monitor (HDMI+DP), Ergotron monitor arm, and a thick anti-fatigue standing mat. Moving end of week, need gone today/tomorrow. Pics in the thread :package: 
ajay: pics pls
maria: ```
27" Dell U2719D - good condition, minor scratch on bottom bezel
Ergotron LX monitor arm - VESA 100
Standing mat - 3ft x 2ft, foam still firm
Cables: 1x HDMI, 1x DP (both working)
```
taylor: I can take the monitor if it's still available. Can swing by at 12:30pm today @maria :thumbsup:
sam k: I have two GA concert tix for April 10 that I don't need anymore — trade offer? I can bring a cart to help move stuff. :guitar: :question:
maria: Funny you mention tix — I actually have 2 extra local concert tickets too. Not selling them, but I'll do a tiny raffle: anyone who claims an item and picks up gets 1 entry. Winner DM'd tonight at 6pm. Fair? :tada:
leo: Count me in for the raffle. Love a good curbside lottery. :grin:
ops-bot: Heads up — building curbside rules: please do not block the loading bay. Deliveries only allowed 9am-5pm. See https://building.example/curbside for details.
taylor: Confirmed for 12:30pm pickup. @maria I'll bring a small dolly, can help move the arm if someone else claims it.
ajay: If taylor flakes, I'll take the arm. Otherwise happy to assist with carry-out. :handshake:
maria: Saved for taylor. If you need me to separate the arm and mat and leave them by the loading gate, ping me when you're outside. Raffle winner will be DM'd at 6pm and please bring ID for lobby. Thanks y'all!
sam k: Awesome — thanks for organizing the giveaway, this is great. If i win the tix i'll give them to a friend. :pray:
